Google Business text has no phone, links, hashtags, caps or offers; post type Update. New on screen: Nutritionist CY (real staff, look from Yeoh's photo) debuts. Supermarket shelf brand logos in scene 6 were blurred. One motion clip carries a small PixVerse watermark. Confirm CY is happy to appear before posting.

Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Not sure how much sugar is in your snack? Flip the pack and divide the grams by four. 🍪 That simple trick is the heart of Episode 4 of our Uncle Lim family story. Mei discovers her father's secret stash of biscuits and sweet drinks, and he insists the packet with a green leaf must be healthy. At Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall, our nutritionist turns the pack over and our pharmacist shows the family how to read the back. A quick label check for your next grocery run in Johor Bahru: 1. Ignore the front, read the nutrition panel on the back 2. Find the sugars line 3. Divide the grams by four to get teaspoons 4. Check how many servings are in the pack Bring any snack or drink to our counter and we will read the label with you. Our Minute Consult needs no appointment, and Dietitian and Nutrition Counselling is available for everyday meal planning. Ground Floor, Lot G-001, KSL City Mall, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru. We are open from 10AM to 10PM every day.
